visual_elements.description: Definition fraction: dark-red bar with white text 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)', a black fraction line beneath it, and black denominator text 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)' below the line.
Formula block: dark-red box labeled 'Precision =' in white, followed by the fraction TP over TP + FP; to the right is the evaluated example 'Precision= 18/(18+10) =64.3%'.

Two beige callout boxes with small upward pointers: left says 'Positive Classified as +ive', right says 'Negative Classified as +ive'. A green curly brace sits beneath both, with the text 'All Samples classified as Positive'.
Light-blue rounded box with blue border and blue text: 'If you said: the sample is positive, can I trust you ? At what %?'

Generic confusion matrix. Header 'Predicted as' spans columns P and N. Row label 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = TP green; Actual P / Predicted N = FN red/pink; Actual N / Predicted P = FP red/pink; Actual N / Predicted N = TN green.
Numeric confusion matrix with same structure: Actual P row has 18 under P and 12 under N; Actual N row has 10 under P and 60 under N. The 18 cell is highlighted with a blue outline.

Two-branch tree under headers 'Positive' and 'Negative'. Left branch: red circular node with white plane icon labeled 30, arrows down to red node 18 labeled TP and green node 12 labeled FN. Right branch: green circular node with white plane icon labeled 70, arrows down to green node 60 labeled TN and red node 10 labeled FP.
Yellow circle in the top-right corner containing the slide number '7'.

imagery: White airplane/paper-plane silhouettes inside the red and green circular nodes at the top of the Positive and Negative branches; no photographs are used.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. The title is very large, bold, and dark red. Section label 'Meaning' is bold red. Body text is black, with key terms such as POSITIVE, Predicted, and Positive emphasized in dark red or bold. Table and node labels are small and bold; all-caps is used for POSITIVE, TP, FP, FN, TN, P, and N. The bottom prompt is blue.
animation_state: No visible build or animation state; all elements appear fully revealed.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to #F4F4F4. 2. Add the title 'Precision' at the top center/left in bold dark red #B00000, approximately 54 pt sans-serif. 3. In the upper left, place a dark red #B00000 bar with white text 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)'; draw a black fraction line under it; below the line add black text 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)'. 4. Add the red bold label 'Meaning', then below it add '% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive', emphasizing 'Predicted' and 'POSITIVE' in dark red. 5. Add the formula block: a dark red box with white text 'Precision =', then a fraction with 'TP' over 'TP + FP'; to the right add 'Precision= 18/(18+10) =64.3%'. 6. Add two beige callout boxes with small upward pointers: 'Positive Classified as +ive' and 'Negative Classified as +ive'. 7. Add a green curly brace beneath the callouts and the text 'All Samples classified as Positive'. 8. At the bottom left, add a light-blue #E3F2FD box with a #1976D2 border and blue text 'If you said: the sample is positive, can I trust you ? At what %?'. 9. In the top right, build a 2x2 confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as' over P and N; row label 'Actual' with rows P and N; fill TP and TN with light green #C8E6C9 and FN and FP with light red/pink #FFCDD2. 10. Below it, build the numeric matrix with the same headers and rows: 18, 12, 10, 60; outline the 18 cell in blue #1976D2. 11. In the lower right, create the two-branch tree: headers 'Positive' in red and 'Negative' in green; left branch red node 30 with a white plane icon, arrows to red node 18 labeled TP and green node 12 labeled FN; right branch green node 70 with a white plane icon, arrows to green node 60 labeled TN and red node 10 labeled FP. 12. Add a yellow #FFEB3B circle in the top-right corner with the number '7'.
